methods.ancestry: Source commit is an ancestor of pinned main.
methods.merged-pr: GitHub attests this source tip was merged directly to main and its recorded merge SHA is reachable from pinned main. Applies to squash merges. Current behavior may have changed.
methods.historical-paths: Every changed path from the unique merge base matches the donor in mode and final object (including absent files) at the same first-parent main witness descending from that base. The exact delta was present then. Later main can supersede it.
methods.tree-equality: The source and main tree objects are identical.
methods.path-equality: Every source-changed path from the recorded merge base has the same mode and final object on pinned main, including deletions.
methods.noop-merge: A clean three-way Git tree merge yields the exact main tree.
methods.empty-delta: The donor and its merge base have identical trees.
methods.review-unchanged: A committed independent whole-donor disposition records supersession. Every path it accounted for still matches the reviewed target tree on pinned main.
methods.dated-prompt: The sole changed file is an October 30 or November 4 coordinator prompt tied to an old main. Preserve the historical record; current direction and docs/engineering/task-ledger.json supersede it for operation.
methods.packaging-review: The complete 11-path donor was previously reviewed. Pinned main retains the recovered concurrency, empty-upload and downloaded-artifact controls. The remaining historical dev/build pins are still unvalidated.
methods.docs-tests-delta: A clean synthetic merge changes only docs/tests. The witness is a path count. This establishes textual difference; usefulness and behavior require review.
methods.nonempty-merge: A clean synthetic merge changes main. The witness is a path count. Do not infer useful missing behavior from that count.
methods.merge-conflict: A synthetic tree merge conflicts; witness is the merge base. Retain for manual comparison.
methods.no-single-base: No unique base was available. An empty witness denotes unrelated histories.

limitations: Historical integration does not certify current feature behavior. Living project branches and PRs can change after the captured refs.
Scope-only earlier reviews never settle the whole branch. Current path counts certify blob/mode checks, not fresh behavioral tests.
Open GitHub PR merge_sha values can denote synthetic test merges. Only merged state plus reachable recorded merge SHA establishes recorded integration.

The 130-commit first-parent history was checked for whole historical path matches among textually unresolved branches with a unique merge base. A historical witness is narrower than a current behavior guarantee.
Categories do not authorize blanket cherry-picking, branch deletion, or release.
